## Victim Simulator Behavior

The `sc03-victim` container simulates realistic employee behavior:
- Checks inbox at configurable intervals (default: 30s)
- Clicks phishing links from expected senders
- Submits credentials to the landing page
- Generates beacon telemetry to C2 host
